Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against human Cytochrome P450 2C9. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering by target name 'Cytochrome P450 2C9' and organism 'Homo sapiens'. Require structures via an INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
